what: Full nine-arm same-seed reproduction of the section 1.1 control battery.
provenance: Colab A100-SXM4-40GB, 2026-07-25. run_benign at seed 20260726, the committed protocol and estimator, 2160 generations across 9 arms. Run because the original per-draw records had been lost to a VM recycle, leaving the TEMPLATE_DECOMP pre-registration undischarged.
kind: SAME-SEED REPRODUCTION, not an independent replication. It shows the pipeline is deterministic and that the published numbers are what the committed code produces on different hardware. It does NOT retroactively support the 'independent re-run' claim retracted in section 1.1.
summary: All four published double differences reproduce to every printed digit; both organisms cross the pre-registered -0.15 threshold with intervals excluding zero; the placebo and all five recipe-matched benign fine-tunes remain null. The FPR 0/5 verdict reproduces.
